stem: Why does Alejandro allow the old woman to stay in the clinic?

options.label: F
options.text: He wants to be present when the old woman's granddaughter arrives.

options.label: G
options.text: He doesn’t want to release her until the results of her blood test arrive.

options.label: H
options.text: He assumes that the nursing home director has political connections.

options.label: J
options.text: He doesn’t trust the nursing home staff to know how to care for her.
